summary: Oversized leaf, fails both leaf limits. Named changed subsystems count 4 (creature simulation, procedural creature rendering, world content data, headless scenario tests) against the 3-responsibility limit, and the behavior is 4-6 independently testable species signature rules plus the new friendly-interaction rules (friendly floor is its own proof obligation), not one behavior. Useful split: promote WI-03b to stories/ST-WI-03b/plan.md (id WI-03b, kind: story, parent ST-03, inherits ST-01/ST-02 deps) with two leaves: (1) WI-03b1 - CreatureDefs plus simulation interactions for the tier's signature rules including the at-least-2 friendly behaviors, with per-species headless signature tests and the friendly-floor check (subsystems: world content data, creature simulation, headless scenario tests; carries AC-roster-behavior and AC-roster-tests, owns the 2+ friendly floor evidence); (2) WI-03b2, depends_on WI-03b1 - tier-2 spawns in production world data at band density with section 34 caps, data-driven small/medium body shapes on the existing WI-02b renderer pipeline, and the one browser spot-check (subsystems: world content data, procedural creature rendering; carries AC-roster-count and AC-roster-tests). Each leaf then has <=3 changed subsystems and one focused behavior; criteria text is retained verbatim, their union covers all three parent criteria, and WI-03c stays the final AC-roster-behavior proof owner per the ST-03 plan (existing WI-03c dependency on WI-03b then means all its leaves).
